If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds. Koti-1 runs at 25 MHz (the VGA
pixel clock IS the core clock), so 40 ns is the real target.
Hold slack margin. These are DELIBERATELY BELOW the TT default (0.1/0.05).
At the TT default the 8x2 harden dies in ResizerTimingPostCTS: 2203 hold
endpoints -> 2259 hold buffers -> [DPL-0034] 398 instances -> [DPL-0036]
detailed placement failed. The die is already at ~87% util after slew/fanout
repair (GPL then inflates the placement target to 0.9856), so there is no
room to legalize a hold-buffer flood. Setup is NOT the constraint here:
CLOCK_PERIOD is 40 ns (25 MHz) and only 137 setup endpoints needed repair,
so the 0.1 ns pad was pure conservatism. 0.02/0.01 are the values the
console chip uses on the same 8x2 die.
EXP 2C: buy back area so the ~1000 antenna DIODES can legalize, instead of
avoiding diodes altogether (that is branch harden-hold-margin / exp 2A).
repair_design runs with -slew_margin 20 -cap_margin 20, i.e. it buffers any
net within 20% of the liberty limit, not just violating ones: 3076 buffers /
28394 um2 = 9.4% of the core, on a design whose base util is already 0.749.
Setting the padding to 0 still meets the library's real max_transition and
max_capacitance -- the limits signoff STA checks -- so this removes
conservatism, not correctness.
===== DRV constraints: the real source of the buffer bloat =====
The sky130_fd_sc_hd LibreLane PDK config pins MAX_TRANSITION_CONSTRAINT to
0.75 ns and MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT to 10. Those two produce 509 slew + 553
fanout violations -> 3076 repair buffers -> 28394 um2 = 9.4% of the core,
on a design that has no room (base util 0.749, GPL inflates the placement
target to 0.9856 for routability).
0.75 ns is HALF what the library itself asks for: sky130_fd_sc_hd's own
liberty declares default_max_transition : 1.5 ns (per-cell max_transition
values go higher still). 1.5 ns is therefore the LIBRARY's limit, not an
invented number - and it is still only 3.75% of the 40 ns clock period,
against which this design has enormous setup slack (137 endpoints, all
repaired). Fanout is not itself an electrical limit; slew is, and slew
stays bounded at the library value, so the resizer still buffers wherever
transition actually demands it.
===== last mile: 25 instances still would not legalize after diodes =====
Exp 3 took the unlegalizable count 140 -> 116 -> 25. Two final levers, both
aimed straight at that residue rather than at global area:
(1) Antenna repair over-fixes by 10% (repair_antennas -ratio_margin 10),
i.e. it inserts diodes for nets that are within 10% of the rule but not
actually violating. 0 fixes exactly what the antenna rule requires --
and the rule, not the margin, is what signoff checks. Fewer diodes =
fewer new cells to place.
(2) Detailed placement was searching for a legal site within only 100 um
vertically (detailed_placement -max_displacement 500 100) on a core
that is 223.04 um tall, so it could not use most of the die's height
to rehome a displaced cell. Give it the full core in both axes; with
hold already repaired and 40 ns of period, the timing cost of a longer
move is affordable here.
===== EXP 5A: insert antenna diodes EARLY, not post-route =====
Exp 4 proved the residue is not an area problem: it cut repair buffers
1004 -> 540 and antenna violations 744 -> 550, yet the unlegalizable count
went 25 -> 27. More free area does not help, because by the time
OpenROAD.RepairAntennas runs the design is already ROUTED and the diodes
have to squeeze into whatever sites survive locally.
Odb.HeuristicDiodeInsertion instead places diodes at GLOBAL PLACEMENT, from
the Manhattan length of the not-yet-routed nets, and then legalizes with a
normal detailed placement + global routing - i.e. while the placer can still
move things. Its docstring requires GPL_CELL_PADDING and DPL_CELL_PADDING
> 0 to work reliably (padding is what reserves the sites the diodes land
in); both are 0 today (global_placement ran -pad_right 0 -pad_left 0).
1 site costs ~18876 * 0.46 * 2.72 = ~23.6k um2 (~7.8% of core), which is
affordable now that exp 3+4 gave back ~24k um2 of repair buffers.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
